Definition: properly, glistening, i.e. a burnished plate; also a flower (as bright-colored); a wing (as gleaming in the air)
BiblicalUsage: tsîyts stands behind the English phrase a blossom, a shining plate. In Exodus 28:36, thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and it appears again in Leviticus 8:9.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsîyts exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
